scope: all nondegenerate-positive symmetric-secant positive-Pfaffian doublezero a=q=0, rho(rho2-1)!=0
matrix_identities: F*H=I, detF=1, F(A)=B; exact conic identities
structural_proof: xy=A,yx=B and opposite F normalizers imply all negative symmetric quadratics central in negative subalgebra. Auxiliary weights +/-1 normal cubic components force Sym2F=I, hence F=+/-I, impossible rho!=0. Weights +/-3 require F3=-I, equivalent traceF=1.
all_normal_cuts: at traceF1, W=span(x3,y3); (x+theta*y)(x2-theta*F2(A)+theta2*y2)=x3+theta3*y3. Every cut factors over algebraically closed k.
coverage_reduction: x/y interchange with u/v multiplied by i sends rho to -rho and (a,q,s,t) to (-q,-a,alpha*s,t); all remaining points have q!=0, normalized q1 by positive torus
geometric_conclusion: entire doublezero boundary has no H3
